experiment: Impact of resampling and cost-sensitive learning on probability calibration for stunting prediction (SKI 2023)

split.outer: StratifiedGroupKFold(5, shuffle, seed 42), group = household (ID RT)
split.inner: StratifiedGroupKFold(4) on development part -> 1 fold calibration (~20%), rest training (~60%)

preprocessing: median imputation + missing indicators + StandardScaler (numeric); constant 'MISSING' + OneHotEncoder(min_frequency=50) (categorical); fit on training only

imbalance_strategies.SMOTE: k=5, to 1:1, applied in encoded feature space

calibration.PLATT: logistic regression on logit(p), fitted on calibration set
calibration.ISO: isotonic regression on p, fitted on calibration set

evaluation.metrics: AUC, PR-AUC, Brier, BSS, log loss, ECE (10 equal-width bins), adaptive ECE, MCE, calibration slope & intercept, O/E, Spiegelhalter Z, Murphy decomposition, Sens/Spec/F1/MCC at 0.5 and at training prevalence

software_cloud_run: Python 3.11.15, scikit-learn 1.8.0, numpy 2.4.4, pandas 3.0.2, scipy 1.17.1, matplotlib 3.10.9
